about:
# NicCopyTooltip

A World of Warcraft addon that captures a full item tooltip as plain text and presents it in a copyable popup — useful for sharing item details anywhere outside the game.

---

## What it does

Hover over any item (in your bags, equipment slots, loot windows, the auction house, etc.) and trigger the addon with your keybind or the slash command `/nct`. A popup appears with the complete tooltip text, pre-selected and ready to copy.

The output includes the item link, rarity, and all tooltip lines with color codes stripped, formatted as plain text.

---

## Installation

1. Download `NicCopyTooltip.zip` from the latest release
2. Unzip it — you will get a `NicCopyTooltip` folder
3. Place the `NicCopyTooltip` folder in the `Interface/AddOns/` directory of your game client (for example `World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/` or `World of Warcraft/_classic_era_/Interface/AddOns/`)
4. Launch or reload WoW (`/reload`)

---

## Usage

1. Hover your mouse over any item
2. Press your configured keybind **or** type `/nct`
3. The popup opens with the tooltip text already highlighted
4. Press **Ctrl+C** (or **Cmd+C** on Mac) to copy, then paste wherever you like
5. Click **Close** or press **Escape** to dismiss

---

## Setting your keybind

1. Open **Game Menu → Key Bindings** (or press **Escape → Key Bindings**)
2. Scroll to the **NicCopyTooltip** section near the bottom
3. Click the binding slot and press your preferred key combination

---

## Requirements

One download works on all of these clients:

| Client | Game version | Interface |
|---|---|---|
| Retail | 12.1 | 120100 |
| Mists of Pandaria Classic | 5.5 | 50504 |
| Burning Crusade Anniversary | 2.5 | 20506 |
| Classic Era / Hardcore | 1.15 | 11509 |
| WoW Forever | 1.60 | 16001 |

---

## Version

See Releases for the current version and changelog.

# Nic Copy Tooltip

## [v1.0.25](https://github.com/jpwalsh1/nic-copytooltip/tree/v1.0.25) (2026-10-06)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/jpwalsh1/nic-copytooltip/commits/v1.0.25) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/jpwalsh1/nic-copytooltip/releases)

- v1.0.25 - Support Classic Era, Mists Classic, TBC Anniversary and WoW Forever  
    - List every current client in one TOC: 120100 (retail 12.1), 50504  
      (Mists Classic), 20506 (TBC Anniversary), 11509 (Classic Era) and  
      16001 (WoW Forever). Retail moves up from the outdated 120001.  
    - Hook GameTooltip OnTooltipSetItem wherever it exists. Classic clients  
      expose TooltipDataProcessor, but their item tooltips only fire the  
      legacy script, so the addon never captured anything there.  
    - Fall back to the global GetItemInfo when C\_Item.GetItemInfo is missing.  
    - Read ITEM\_ID from the item link when the legacy hook passes no data.  
    - README: list supported clients and generic install path.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

# Nic Copy Tooltip

## [v1.0.24](https://github.com/jpwalsh1/nic-copytooltip/tree/v1.0.24) (2026-03-31)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/jpwalsh1/nic-copytooltip/commits/v1.0.24) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/jpwalsh1/nic-copytooltip/releases)

- v1.0.24 - Fix WoW 12.x secret value LUA errors and API deprecations  
    - Add type() guard before string.gsub on tooltip line text in both the  
      TooltipDataProcessor path and the GetText() fallback path. In WoW 12.x  
      the sell price line is a secret value object, not a string, causing  
      1800+ repeated LUA errors on loot window and herb hover.  
    - Replace GetItemInfo() with C\_Item.GetItemInfo() (deprecated since 10.2.6)  
    - Add WoW Token (quality 8) to QUALITY\_NAMES table  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
